issue_title: `FileProxy.isatty()` always returns `False` instead of delegating to the proxied file

validator.fix_summary: Added an isatty() method to rich.file_proxy.FileProxy that delegates to the proxied underlying file: `def isatty(self) -> bool: return self.__file.isatty()`. Root cause is that io.TextIOBase (a base class of FileProxy) defines isatty() in the MRO, so the class's generic __getattr__ delegation is never consulted for isatty. The explicit override mirrors the existing fileno() delegation. This is identical in effect to the maintainer fix in PR #4077. Verified without reading the PR source diff.
